subject: Is there a function to keep loci?

messages.author: 872b7858ea2488c0
messages.subject: Is there a function to keep loci?
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to filter out linkage disequilibrium and have converted the genlight to SNPRelate to filter out LD. This seems to identify which loci are below the threshold you set.

From here I want to filter out loci in dartR. There are ~7000 loci that I want to remove from the genlight file. I have tried copy and pasting all the names into the gl.drop.loci function, but R stops working after I copy and paste the 7,000 loci names in.

I was wondering if there is a a type of gl.keep.loci function? This would be much more practical in my situation, where I only want to keep about 100 loci.

If anyone has any suggestions to solve this issue, I would greatly appreciate any feedback.

Kind regards,
Chad

messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Is there a function to keep loci?

There is a gl.keep.loc function in dartR.
